title: 第9章 你要打我就陪你打第10章 斩妖盟
slug: 惊天剑帝第7906章空气太敏感
content_zh:
听见铁海棠说自己是斩妖盟盟主之女，林白喜出望外。
“真的？”林白问道。
铁海棠笑道：“如假包换！”
“那太好了，姑娘，你可不可以帮我牵个路，让我进去斩妖盟呀。”
如果有铁海棠引路，那林白进入斩妖盟或许会省去许多的周折。
“那当然可以，你有这么高的武道修为，又有这么高深莫测的剑法，你进入斩妖盟，直接可以进入核心武者之列！”铁海棠欢喜的笑道。
“我们斩妖盟，正需要像你这种侠义之士的加入！”
铁海棠由衷的笑道。
林白摆摆手道：“哈哈，我可不是什么侠义之士，也不想做什么核心弟子，我只想得到这青灵山脉的地图，和所有妖兽的所在。”
“这个自然可以，但是地图是我们斩妖盟的命脉所在，非核心武者，是不能观看的。”铁海棠道。
“是这样啊，那好吧，全由姑娘安排。”林白点了点头。
“好，我们稍后就返回斩妖盟，但是现在我得先去解决这些杂碎！”铁海棠展颜一笑。
“杂碎？”
林白不解的说着。
抬头一看，原先那些擎天盟的武者，听见林中有打斗之声，便急速回来。
恰好，他们一回来，就看见了倒在地上已经死去的秦响！
“少盟主，你怎么了？”
“啊！少盟主死了！”
这些擎天盟的武者吓了一跳，浑身是汗。
“秦响死了，你们这些狗腿子下地狱去继续做他的狗腿子吧！”铁海棠从手腕之中一抽，一杆三米多长的烈焰枪便出现在她手中。

长枪横扫，将几个擎天盟武者直接击杀！
“她是从什么地方抽出这把兵刃的！”
林白惊骇了一下：“难道是……储物空间！”
林白也加入了战斗，与铁海棠一起，几下子将这些擎天盟的武者，全部斩杀。
铁海棠走到秦响的身边，将他手腕上的一枚银色戒指取下来，丢给了林白说道：“这是秦响的储物戒指，他本来就是你杀的，这戒指就该是你的，你将心神沉入其中，就能开启储物戒指。”
“多谢。”林白爱不释手的把玩着这枚银色戒指。
林白早就听说，这天下有能人异士能开辟空间，锻造储物之地。
而刚才有在铁海棠的手中看见了储物空间，让林白心中火热，刚才还在心中暗暗发誓，自己怎么也要弄一个来玩玩，没想到这时候就得到了。
“原来这就是储物空间啊，我还以为是一个随便的装饰戒指呢。”林白憨笑一声，刚刚击杀秦响，他的确没有看出来这戒指有什么高明之处，平淡无奇，原本以为是装饰所用，却没有想到是储物空间！
“走吧，我带你回斩妖盟！”
“好。”
林白与铁海棠，一路谈笑着，走向了斩妖盟。
青灵山脉当中有一条庞大的山脉，将此划分东南。
南边，便是斩妖盟的地盘，东边便是擎天盟的地盘，二者相互不过界。
但擎天盟要灭斩妖盟的心，已经是路人皆知了。这些年，擎天盟和斩妖盟也是闹得不可开交。
南边山脉，有一片巨大的天然峡谷，其内石壁被人凿传形成一个个的洞府。
此地便是斩妖盟的山门所在。
“大小姐回来了！”
“大小姐，这个小白脸是谁呀，该不会是你在外面养的汉子吧。”
content_en:
Lin Bai was overjoyed when he heard Tie Haitang say that she was the daughter of the leader of the Demon Slayer Alliance.
"Really?" Lin Bai asked.
Tie Haitang smiled and said, "It's guaranteed to be replaced if it's fake!"
"That's great, girl, can you help me lead the way to the Demon Slayer Alliance?"
If Tie Haitang had led the way, Lin Bai might have saved himself a lot of trouble by joining the Demon Slayer League.
"Of course you can. You have such a high level of martial arts cultivation and such unpredictable swordsmanship. If you join the Demon Slayer Alliance, you can directly enter the core warriors!" Tie Haitang said with a happy smile.
"Our Demon Slayer Alliance needs chivalrous people like you to join us!"
Tie Haitang smiled sincerely.
Lin Bai waved his hands and said: "Haha, I am not a chivalrous person, and I don't want to be a core disciple. I just want to get the map of the Qingling Mountains and the locations of all the monsters."
"Of course this is possible, but the map is the lifeblood of our Demon Slayer Alliance. Non-core warriors cannot view it," Tie Haitang said.
"That's right, okay then, it's all up to the girl." Lin Bai nodded.
"Okay, we will return to the Demon Slayer Alliance later, but now I have to deal with these bastards first!" Tie Haitang smiled.
"Giblets?"
Lin Bai said puzzledly.
Looking up, the warriors from the Qingtian Alliance hurried back when they heard the sound of fighting in the forest.
Coincidentally, when they came back, they saw Qin Xiang lying dead on the ground!
"Young leader, what's wrong with you?"
"Ah! The young leader is dead!"
These Qingtian Alliance warriors were startled and covered in sweat.
"Qin Xiang is dead, you losers should go to hell and continue to be his losers!" Tie Haitang pulled out her wrist, and a three-meter-long flame gun appeared in her hand.
The spear swept across and killed several Qingtian Alliance warriors directly!
"Where did she draw this weapon from?"
Lin Bai was horrified: "Is it... a storage space?"
Lin Bai also joined the battle, and together with Tie Haitang, killed all these Qingtian Alliance warriors in a few strokes.
Tie Haitang walked to Qin Xiang, took off a silver ring from his wrist, threw it to Lin Bai and said, "This is Qin Xiang's storage ring. You were the one who killed him. This ring should be yours. You can open the storage ring by sinking your mind into it."
"Thank you." Lin Bai played with the silver ring fondly.
Lin Bai had long heard that there were capable people in this world who could open up space and forge storage places.
And just now he saw the storage space in Tie Haitang's hand, which made Lin Bai feel hot. Just now he secretly swore in his heart that he would get one to play with, but he didn't expect to get it at this time.
"So this is a storage space. I thought it was a random decorative ring." Lin Bai laughed innocently. He had just killed Qin Xiang. He really didn't see anything clever about this ring. It was ordinary. He originally thought it was for decoration, but he didn't expect it to be a storage space!
"Let's go, I'll take you back to the Demon Slayer Alliance!"
"Okay."
Lin Bai and Tie Haitang walked towards the Demon Slayer Alliance, talking and laughing all the way.
There is a huge mountain range in the Qingling Mountains that divides it to the southeast.
To the south is the territory of the Demon-Slaying Alliance, and to the east is the territory of the Qingtian Alliance. The two are within the boundaries of each other.
But it is already known to everyone that the Qingtian League wants to destroy the Demon Slayer League. In recent years, the Qingtian Alliance and the Demon-Slaying Alliance have also been in trouble.
In the southern mountains, there is a huge natural canyon, and the stone walls inside have been chiselled to form caves.
This place is where the mountain gate of the Demon Slayer Alliance is located.
"The eldest lady is back!"
"Miss, who is this pretty boy? Is he the man you raised outside?"
